topic: Paris, 1889: the Eiffel Tower was built for a world fair and was the tallest structure in the world for about 40 years.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Paris’s Sky-High Surprise

shots.narration: Golden sparkles! A giant iron arch appears overhead!
shots.scene: Beneath the Eiffel Tower in Paris, 1889; bright sunlight, towering iron lattice, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize together inside a swirling cloud of golden time-jump sparkles.
shots.mood: Dazzling golden dust beneath immense sunlit ironwork.

shots.scene: A sunlit path beneath the completed Eiffel Tower; Zoya wears her yellow hoodie and cargo shorts beside brass pocket-watch robot Tock.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the enormous tower legs.
shots.mood: Bright welcoming sunlight and lingering blue watch glow.

shots.scene: Close beneath the Eiffel Tower, with its iron lattice extending beyond the upper edge of the vertical frame.
shots.action: Zoya tilts her head far upward.
shots.mood: Wide-eyed curiosity beneath an overwhelming iron canopy.

shots.narration: We're too close to see the whole tower!
shots.scene: At the base of the Eiffel Tower, tightly framed by massive iron supports and pale sky.
shots.action: Zoya shades her eyes with one hand.
shots.mood: Gentle puzzlement, sparkling sunlight between iron beams.

shots.narration: Tock spots a clearer view beyond the trees.
shots.scene: A broad open path leading away from the Eiffel Tower toward a tree-bordered viewing area; no signs or lettering.
shots.action: Tock points his spring tail toward the open path.
shots.mood: Inviting sunlit space framed by leafy green trees.

shots.scene: An open path extending away from the Eiffel Tower, with its lower structure behind the travelers.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock walk together away from the tower.
shots.mood: Playful movement through warm sunshine and soft path dust.

shots.narration: The Eiffel Tower was built for a world fair.
shots.scene: A wider view of the Eiffel Tower from the open path in Paris, 1889; rich iron detail, trees, and bright sky.
shots.action: Zoya gestures toward the tower's sweeping iron arches.
shots.mood: Friendly discovery amid grand sunlit architecture.

shots.narration: Its iron lattice reaches high above us.
shots.scene: The Eiffel Tower's intricate iron lattice rising against a clear blue Paris sky, vertical cinematic 3D composition.
shots.action: A small white cloud drifts behind the upper ironwork.
shots.mood: Airy blue sky and warm highlights on intricate metalwork.

shots.narration: [surprised] It was the world's tallest structure for about 40 years!
shots.scene: An open viewing area farther from the Eiffel Tower, with its summit now visible above the travelers.
shots.action: Zoya raises one hand toward the distant summit.
shots.mood: Astonished faces beneath a spectacular sunlit silhouette.

shots.narration: Now we can see the whole tower!
shots.scene: The complete Eiffel Tower fits inside the vertical frame from base to summit; Zoya and Tock stand small in the foreground.
shots.action: Zoya opens her arms beneath the fully revealed tower.
shots.mood: Triumphant wide view, bright sky, golden afternoon light.

shots.narration: A little distance made a giant difference.
shots.scene: The open viewing area with the full Eiffel Tower behind Zoya; her blue wristwatch begins glowing amid golden motes.
shots.mood: Satisfied smiles and a fresh shimmer of time-travel magic.

shots.scene: Beside Zoya's glowing blue wristwatch, Tock's round glass face catches golden sparkles; the Eiffel Tower remains in the background.
shots.action: Tock gestures toward Zoya's glowing watch with his spring tail.
shots.mood: Eager anticipation, swirling golden dust, inviting blue light.

episode.endHook: Zoya’s watch glows again—another adventure is waiting!
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Paris, 1889, to discover the Eiffel Tower! Learn why it was built and how long it held its world-record height.
